verdict.rationale: Datalab exposes a single convert endpoint for "a PDF, image, or document". Its docs name PDFs, Word documents, spreadsheets and images, and its Marker engine on GitHub also lists PPTX, HTML and EPUB, so most of the mix runs through one API without per-format plumbing. Email is never mentioned, and PPTX/HTML support is evidenced only in the open-source Marker repo, not the hosted API docs. missing for 10: email (EML/MSG) support, hosted-API documentation of PPTX and HTML inputs, independent hands-on corroboration of mixed-format handling

support.subject: As a developer, one API handles my whole document mix — PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, images, email — without per-format plumbing
